# Execution scope

Repositories as first-class execution scope (KAIROS-A-0019) and the git forges behind them.

## repositories

### `GET /api/repositories`

The repository directory (open tenant-wide), by slug. `?team=` narrows
to one owning team.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `team` | path | yes | `string`, nullable | Only this team's repositories (UUID or slug). |
| `forge` | path | yes | `string`, nullable | With `name`: the ONE repository registered under this forge (`github|gitlab|other`) and full name — how a checkout matches its git remote (KAIROS-T-0116). Returns an empty list when unknown. |
| `name` | path | yes | `string`, nullable | `owner/repo`, paired with `forge`. |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | array of [`Repository`](schemas.md#repository) | Repositories, by slug |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Unknown team |

### `POST /api/repositories`

Register a repository under its owning team (org admin, or a
`manage_tasks` holder on that team's delivery board — self-serve for
the team and its agents).

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`CreateRepositoryRequest`](schemas.md#createrepositoryrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | [`Repository`](schemas.md#repository) | Registered |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Neither org admin nor the owning team |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Slug or (forge, name) already registered |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Bad slug/forge or unknown team |

### `GET /api/repositories/{slug}`

One repository (open tenant-wide): the directory row plus its webhook
connection id and in-flight links — everything an agent reads before
working in, or filing against, a codebase.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `slug` | path | yes | `string` | Repository slug (or UUID) |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`RepositoryDetail`](schemas.md#repositorydetail) | The repository |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Unknown repository |

### `DELETE /api/repositories/{slug}`

Remove a repository (org admin). Refused with 409 while live tasks or a
live webhook connection still reference it.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `slug` | path | yes | `string` | Repository slug (or UUID) |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`OrgDeleteResponse`](schemas.md#orgdeleteresponse) | Removed |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Not an org admin |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Unknown repository |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Still referenced by tasks or a connection |

### `PATCH /api/repositories/{slug}`

Edit a repository (same gate as create, evaluated against the CURRENT
owner). Re-homing to another team does not touch its tasks.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `slug` | path | yes | `string` | Repository slug (or UUID) |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`UpdateRepositoryRequest`](schemas.md#updaterepositoryrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`Repository`](schemas.md#repository) | Updated |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Neither org admin nor the owning team |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Unknown repository |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Slug already taken |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Bad slug or unknown team |

## forge

### `GET /api/forge-connections`

Every live connection (open tenant-wide; secrets never included).

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | array of [`ForgeConnection`](schemas.md#forgeconnection) | Live connections, newest first |

### `POST /api/forge-connections`

Connect webhooks for a registered repository (org admin). Returns the
delivery URL and the secret — **the only time the secret is ever
shown**. The repository's forge is the webhook dialect; `other` repos
cannot be connected.

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`CreateForgeConnectionRequest`](schemas.md#createforgeconnectionrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | [`CreatedForgeConnection`](schemas.md#createdforgeconnection) | Connected; webhook_secret is shown once |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Not an org admin |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Unknown repository |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Repository already connected |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Repository has no webhook-capable forge |
| `501` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Deployment not configured for webhooks |

### `GET /api/forge-connections/{id}`

One live connection (open tenant-wide).

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | Connection id (UUID) |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`ForgeConnection`](schemas.md#forgeconnection) | The connection |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Unknown connection |

### `DELETE /api/forge-connections/{id}`

Disconnect a repository (soft delete; its links stop being reachable).

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | Connection id (UUID) |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`OrgDeleteResponse`](schemas.md#orgdeleteresponse) | Disconnected |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Not an org admin |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Unknown connection |

### `POST /api/forge-connections/{id}/rotate`

Rotate a connection's secret. Because the secret is DERIVED from the
connection id, rotation mints a **new connection** (same repo, new id)
and disconnects the old one — so the delivery URL changes too and the
operator updates both fields in the forge.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | Connection id (UUID) |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`CreatedForgeConnection`](schemas.md#createdforgeconnection) | Rotated; new URL and secret shown once |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Not an org admin |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Unknown connection |
| `501` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Deployment not configured for webhooks |
